verdict.rationale: Sierra markets an Agent SDK for building 'customer journeys as code' with API-call inspection, implying a programmatic interface exists, but there's no publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or open API reference — docs.sierra.ai is login-gated to contracted customers rather than a documented public API. Missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference/OpenAPI spec, evidence of self-serve API keys or open documentation, independent developer confirmation of using the API without a sales contract.
